<notes>
kept -> base1 -> delivered yes with 26.86, correct filtering and calculation traced; mental LLM parse avoided tool-writing errors
kept -> inv1 -> delivered yes with 26.86, identical harness, same correct result; confirms base harness stability across samples
dropped -> dom1 -> delivered yes but with 35.19, which contradicts base1/inv1 on row inclusion (includes 2025-01-23 with num_tasks=1 when condition requires >3); Python parsing in dom1 trajectory shows data truncation and likely off-by-one column extraction (row 2025-01-22 extracted exercise=89 from study_minutes index instead of 88 from correct index); single failure in 1/3 rollouts is signal of LLM choosing to write tool code and making errors, not a harness defect — base harness succeeds precisely because it avoids such code generation
kept -> base harness design -> simple direct LLM call (no tools, no always-on prose) proved sufficient; both base1 and inv1 parsed complex row-major corrupted data correctly without code, delivered exact correct answer
</notes>

KEEP_BASE
